podcast.title: Member Considered for Soundtrack Song
podcast.body: Cy Curnin, the singer of The Fixx, was considered to record the song "Don't You (Forget About Me)" for *The Breakfast Club* soundtrack. The idea, however, did not materialize, and the song was eventually recorded by Simple Minds. "Nor did the idea of getting Sai Kurnin of the Fix to do it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: MuchMusic Canadian Video Premiere
podcast.body: The Fixx was among the artists whose videos received a "Canadian video premiere" during the launch of MuchMusic on August 31, 1984. This marked their official debut on Canada's first 24-hour music channel. "Plus, the Canadian video premiere of Yes, Elvis Costello, The Fix, Human League, Slay, Culture Club, and a few surprises."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall and Future of the Music Video - Part 1

xref.title: Considered for "Don't You (Forget About Me)"
xref.body: Cy Curnin of The Fixx was considered as a potential artist to record "Don't You (Forget About Me)" for *The Breakfast Club* soundtrack. However, the idea "didn't go anywhere," and the song was eventually recorded by Simple Minds, becoming their biggest hit. "Nor did the idea of getting Sai Kurnin of the Fix to do it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
